title: TFC: Vys's Edition
description:
A modpack that provides a more realistic and challenging way to survive our beloved blocky world. Based on TerraFirmaCraft and Cold Sweat, it will make your bones suffer even more.
Modpack created for Vysy0's series: TFC Vys's Edition (Playlist Name)
body:

<details>
  <summary>About</summary>

# About
 
TFC: Vys's Edition is a modpack trying to be an unique and modern alternative choice for lovers of realism.
[TerraFirmaCraft mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/terrafirmacraft) allows the game to instantly become more realistic and challenging, but with [Cold Sweat](https://modrinth.com/mod/cold-sweat) and [TFC: Cold Sweat](https://modrinth.com/mod/tfc-cold-sweat) it adds more to it. Now you also need to control your body temperature..

It's a small modpack created for Vysy0 Youtube Channel for the upcomming series.
But it's avaible earlier for those who finds it!

Goodluck.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Feautures</summary>
  
# Feautures

1. TerraFirma World Gen, Items and Realistic tool crafting, gathering and more..
2. Cold Sweat's Mechanics, made possible to work with TFC by TFC: Cold Sweat
3. Great Optimalization with Embeddium, Embeddium Extra, ModernFix, Entity Culling and more..
4. Shader Support made possible with NoOculus
5. Custom Main Menu made possible with Fancy Menu
6. Soon to be added: Quests, World Selection Custom Menu and Options Custom Menu

</details>
